ore_redemption.notes: Original powered/off/panel-open console. Hinged upper maintenance cover and stepped output ramp. Source default input north/output south; anchors are adjacent tile centers, directions configurable in game.

mineral_stacker_refinery.notes: Shared base geometry and original stacker atlas for stacking machine and boulder refinery. Source uses same appearance. Stacker input east/output west; refinery directions follow machine rotation. Off state also covers open panel, unanchored and power failure; no invented moving assembly.

boulder_smelter.notes: Two source furnace windows and dark upper/lower lips. On/off follows anchored, panel and power state. Input/output anchors; no underfloor plumbing geometry.

boulder_retrieval_matrix.notes: Low landing platform with M-shaped rear support, off/manual/automatic indicators and original retrieval flash timing. Boulders remain runtime attachments; teleport effect is a separate alpha plane.

ore_silo.notes: Ten-sided domed material silo with separate side controller. Original idle/active status panel; gameplay controls brief activity and remote material storage. No pipes or contents baked into mesh.

plate_press.notes: Open work bay with separate descending ram and four-second press cycle matching source interaction duration. Off/online/loaded indicators. Plate is a runtime attachment; original empty/filled plate sprites retained in atlas.

recycler.notes: Overhead gantry with open intake and five low-poly rollers, original powered/safety-off/panel-open status. Conveyor and blood tint are runtime state outside base mesh; no underfloor belt geometry.
